description: This file defines a PHP test class 'SaleModuleCest' which contains acceptance tests for the Sale module in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM. It includes setup, teardown, and multiple test scenarios for creating, viewing, editing, duplicating, and deleting sale module records.

classes.name: SaleModuleCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for Sale module, containing setup and test scenarios for CRUD and other operations.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test to initialize Faker and seed data.

methods.name: _after
methods.description: Teardown method executed after each test (empty in this case).

methods.description: Test: Creates and deploys a sale module as an admin.

methods.name: testScenarioViewSaleTestModule
methods.description: Test: Views the sale test module to verify deployment.
